text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant 3.Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of postgraduate school 5.English proficiency test certificate 80 or above for TOEFL; 6.0 or above for IELTS; or other certificates which can prove that English is his/her native language or the working language at college. 6.Two letters of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents 7.Personal statement Around 1000 words for Master candidates in Chinese (Chinese-taught programs) or English(English-taught programs).Study and work experience, academic research achievement, planned research proposal should be included, and individual development obje 8.Proof of Working Experience
